title: Fix companion crash and home/search content consistency

spec.problem: Repair actionable bugs in the 2026-10-26 Kiokoto report without changing unrelated work.

acceptance.text: Authenticated companion opens safely with Go hint response; malformed hints stay inside bot error state
Home greetings follow Japan time, auth loading avoids guest flashes, home labels follow locale and CTA stays readable
NHK stored content, availability, source labels and freshness agree; refresh retains content and reports partial upstream failure
Exercise completion persists atomic retry-safe progress; home counts completed exercises while BJT/SRS labels remain explicit
Lesson and profile dark controls are readable; empty levels are hidden only when no public lessons exist; saving and system pages are localized
Dictionary excludes contaminated glosses without truncating pagination; search and daily radar suppress duplicate content
Companion opens/chats without crashing home; session loading and existing-session login navigation behave correctly

spec.expected_behavior: Canonical hint response and validated client input; time-zone greeting; localized home states
spec.observed_behavior: Go companion returns hints but client dereferences primary; home greeting is hardcoded; localized UI leaks Vietnamese
spec.rollback_plan: No schema changes or production backfills. Revert runtime/UI changes to roll back; all existing rows retained. SQL conformance baseline only shrinks resolved drift. Greeting reading is nullable for kana-only greetings per shared DailyGreeting contract.
